Package org.aristonis.diwan.database.schema

Class IndexInfo

java.lang.Object
org.aristonis.diwan.database.schema.IndexInfo
public final class IndexInfo extends Object
One index of a table as the database reports it, from Schema.indexes(String).

Instances are immutable.

  • Constructor Details

    • IndexInfo

      public IndexInfo(String name, List<String> columns, boolean isUnique, boolean isPrimary)
      Creates the description.
      Parameters:
      name - the index name, never null
      columns - the columns in index order, never null; copied
      isUnique - whether the index is unique
      isPrimary - whether the index is the primary key
      Throws:
      NullPointerException - if an argument is null

    • IndexInfo

      public IndexInfo(String name, List<String> columns, boolean isUnique, boolean isPrimary, List<String> orders, List<String> collations, String where)
      Creates the description with column order, collations and a partial-index condition.
      Parameters:
      name - the index name, never null
      columns - the columns in index order, never null; copied
      isUnique - whether the index is unique
      isPrimary - whether the index is the primary key
      orders - "asc" or "desc" for each column, never null; copied
      collations - the collation name of each column, "" for the default, never null; copied
      where - the SQL text of the partial-index condition, or null for a full index
      Throws:
      NullPointerException - if an argument other than where is null
      IllegalArgumentException - if orders or collations differ in size from columns

    • where

      public Optional<String> where()
      Returns the condition of a partial index.

      The text is the database's own: PostgreSQL normalises it ((live = true)), SQLite keeps the text the index was created with, without comments. Compare it within one database, not across them.

      Returns:
      the SQL text after where, or empty for a full index
